description: Create a lead in Pipedrive. title is required, and one of fields.person_id / fields.organization_id is strongly recommended so the lead links to a person/org. Pass any additional Pipedrive field in `fields`, keyed by its field key/name (call the matching list_pipedrive_*_fields tool first to discover custom field keys and, for enum/set fields, their option ids). Common fields: owner_id, label_ids (array), value ({amount, currency}).

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)
